issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota
title: United States v. Bock et al. — Report and Recommendation / Order discussing indictment counts, Doc. 355
notes: Primary judicial source quoting and summarizing the original ECF No. 1 indictment. This pass did not yet capture the original binary indictment itself, so this source establishes the Count 1 charging statute without pretending the ECF 1 PDF has been recovered.
supports: The court states that Count 1 of the 22-CR-223 Indictment charges thirteen defendants with conspiracy to commit wire fraud in violation of 18 U.S.C. §§ 371 and 1343, citing Indictment ¶ 21.
The court states that Counts 2 through 14 charge substantive wire fraud in violation of 18 U.S.C. § 1343.
The court states that Count 15 charges conspiracy to commit federal programs bribery in violation of 18 U.S.C. §§ 371 and 666.
This primary judicial record therefore rules out § 1349 as the statute for the original Bock indictment's Count 1 wire-fraud conspiracy.
does_not_support: That the original ECF No. 1 PDF itself has been captured in this corpus.
A network-wide conclusion that no Feeding Our Future indictment uses § 1349.
Adjudicated guilt merely from the charging-count description.
